SELECT sale_date, channel_code, channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) staff_net, min(etl_loaded_at) mn_etl, max(etl_loaded_at) mx_etl, min(sale_ts_utc) mn_ts, max(sale_ts_utc) mx_ts
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' AND (channel_code <> 'ST' OR channel_id IS NOT NULL AND channel_id NOT IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group='store'))
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
SELECT f.sale_date, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)-f.gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT r.return_date, s.channel_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_ret
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND s.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH s AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-16' GROUP BY ALL),
r AS (SELECT r.return_date d, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-16' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT p.business_date, p.store_id, p.net_sales_before_returns, s.gross_sales, p.returns_net, r.ret, p.net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales p LEFT JOIN s ON s.d=p.business_date AND s.store_id=p.store_id LEFT JOIN r ON r.d=p.business_date AND r.store_id=p.store_id
WHERE p.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-16' AND (p.store_id>=900 OR p.store_id IN (1,2,3)) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT line_no) dn, sum(gross_amount) g, min(sale_date) d, max(sale_date) d2 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.d, count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN l.n<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cnt_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN l.n<>l.dn THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dup_lineno, sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN l.d<>l.d2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_date,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)<>l.d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utcdate_differs, sum(o.order_total_gross) ordtot, sum(l.g) linegross
FROM l JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=l.receipt_id
WHERE l.d BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT business_date, store_id, receipts, units_sold, net_sales_before_returns, returns_net, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-25' ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) = sale_date THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) mismatch_local,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE) = sale_date THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) mismatch_plus2
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24'

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, w.n_orders, w.statuses FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(order_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE) od, count(*) n_orders, string_agg(DISTINCT status, ',') statuses FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1) w ON w.od=d.calendar_date WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.return_date, st.store_id, s.channel_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-16' AND (s.channel_id IN (2,3) OR s.sales_line_id IS NULL OR st.store_id>=900)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH days AS (
  SELECT calendar_date AS sale_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'),
sales AS (
  SELECT sale_date, sum(net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group = 'web') AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS sale_date, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group = 'web') AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.sale_date, s.sales_net AS net_sales_before_returns, coalesce(r.refund_net,0) AS returns_net, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refund_net,0) AS net_sales
FROM days d LEFT JOIN sales s USING (sale_date) LEFT JOIN rets r USING (sale_date) ORDER BY 1
